spans.s:
m. (-ङ्कः)
1 A heron.
2 YAMA or death.
3 A false or pretended

Brahman.
4
A title of YUDHIṢṬHIRA, from his assuming the disguise of a

Brahman.
5

A man of the second or military tribe.
6 One of the eighteen division of the continent.
7 The brother of KAṂ

SA.
8

A kind of mango.
f. (-ङ्का)
1 A daughter of

UGRASENA.
2

A sort of sandal.
E.
ककि to go, अच् aff.

f. (-ङ्का)
Scent of the lotus.

m. (-टः)
Mail, defensive armour.
E.
ककि to go, Uṇādi affix अटन्, and with कन् added कङ्कटक.

f. (-री)
Turmerick.

mn. (-णः-णं)
1 A bracelet or ornament of the wrist.
2 A string or ribbon tied round the wrist.
3 An ornament or trinket.
4 A crest.
f. (-णी)
A small bell or tinkling ornament; also किङ्किणी and कङ्कणीका.
E.
कं happily, agreeably, कण to sound, or the reiterative form of कण and अच् affix, fem. affix ङीष्.

f. (-का)
See कङ्कणी.
E.
कण to sound in the reiterative form, and ईकन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-तिका or -ती-तं)
A comb, an instrument for cleaning the hair.
m. (-तः)
A tree.
E.
ककि to go, अतच् affix, fem. ङीष्, or कन् added in the fem. form.

m. (-टः)
A kind of fish commonly Kankila, (Esox Cancila, HAM.)
E.
कङ्क a heron, and त्रोटि, the throat; whose long snout resembles the beak of a heron; also कङ्कत्रोटि.

m. (-टिः)
A kind of fish: see the preceding; also जलसूचि.

m. (-त्रः)
An arrow.
E.
कङ्क, and पत्र leaf, (feather.)

f. (-ला)
Beating time by clapping the hands: see करताली.

m. (-खः)
A pair of tongs.
n. (-खं)
A sort of forceps.
E.
कङ्क, and मुख the mouth; heron-mouthed.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Vile, bad.
n. (-रं)
Buttermilk mixed with water. see कञ्जर.
E.
क implying bad, or कं water, कर what does or makes.

m. (-लः)
A small tree, (Alangium hexapetalum): see निकोचक; the word in the dialects Kāṅkarol is applied to a species of gourd, (Momordica mixta.)

n. (-ड्यं)
A kind of drug.

m. (-त्रुः)
A plant, (Hedysarum gangeticum): see शालपर्णी.
E.
कङ्क a heron, and शत्रु an enemy.

m. (-यः)
A dog.
E.
कङ्क a heron, and शाय sleeping, sleeping like a heron, from शीङ्^1 and घञ् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20161216. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/323, batch 315-320.

m. (-लः)
The skeleton.
E.
ककि to go, कालच् aff.

m. (-ली)
A title of ŚIVA.
E.
कङ्काल, माला, a necklace, and इनि affix; whose necklace is formed of bones.

m. (-ङ्कुः)
1 The brother of KAṂ

SA.
2

A sort of Panic: see कङ्गु.
E.
ककि to go, उ aff.

n. (-ष्टं)
A medicinal earth, described as of two colours, one of a silvery and one of a gold colour, or one of a light and one of a dark yellow.

m. (-रुः)
A kind of crow.
E.
कङ्क an imitative sound, ईर to send, to utter, उ aff.

m. (-लिः)
The Asoka tree, (Jonesia asoca); also कङ्केल्लि.

m. (-ल्लिः)
A tree, (Jonesia asoca, Rox.)

m. (-ल्लः)
A kind of potherb, (Chenopodium esculentum, Rox.) see वास्तुक.

m. (-ङ्खः)
Enjoyment, fruition.
E.
कखि to deride, अच् aff.

f. (-ङ्गुः)
A kind of Panick seed, (Panicum Italicum); several varieties of it are cultivated, and form articles of food for the poor.
E.
क water, अगि to go, कु affix; also with ऊङ् affix कङ्गू, and with कन् added कङ्गुका.

f. (-नी)
A sort of Panick: see the last.

f. (-त्रा)
A kind of grass.

m. (-लः)
The hand.

mfn. (-ङ्क्षन्-ङ्क्ष-न्ती-ङ्क्षत्)
Wishing, desiring, hoping.
E.
काक्षि to desire, शतृ aff.

f. (-ङ्क्षा)
Wish, inclination, desire.
E.
काक्षि to wish, अच् and टाप् affs.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Wished, desired.
E.
काक्षि to wish, क्त aff.

m. (-रुः)
A heron.

f. (-ङ्गा)
Orris root.
E.
का bad, crooked, and अङ्ग body, shape.
